proposedRepresentation.note: A specification for a later lane. The source gate that previously blocked it has passed and the fixtures now render, but installing it would still represent in runtime a packet family whose output no human has reviewed or approved.
proposedRepresentation.componentNote: All three components name TF-805 as their official form, and measurement confirms why: they are blocks on one two-page binary rather than separate documents. Measured -- the certificate of service is enclosed in a stroked box on page 2 at x 56.40..553.65, y 501.62..604.22, and the proposed order runs below it from the ORDER heading at y=483.30 to the foot of the page. The order block carries four stroked checkboxes and no AcroForm widget whatsoever, so the proposed_order component has ZERO write boxes and the platform can write nothing into it.

installPreconditions.precondition: a census-v1 field map is measured off the verified binary
installPreconditions.evidence: field-census.census-v1.json and production-field-map.json; cross-checked in measurement-vs-inherited.json

installPreconditions.precondition: canonical and boundary fixtures render, and are verified from the rendered bytes
installPreconditions.evidence: reports/rendered-artifacts.json, reports/charge-caption-proof.json, reports/participant-name-placement.json, reports/service-block-proof.json; build-findings.json records zero blocking findings

installPreconditions.precondition: an independent visual review is recorded against rastered pages
installPreconditions.detail: All four pages were rastered and reviewed, but by the same agent that rendered them. reports/independent-visual-review.json records the observations and states plainly that it does not discharge f_independent_visual_review_required.

installPreconditions.precondition: completed-output legal approval is granted by a reviewer with that authority
installPreconditions.detail: Requested in approval-request.json. This lane cannot grant it.

previouslyBlockedBy: source_binary_absent -- discharged; the source is verified and the family is built
whyStillNotInstalled: Installing is a separate act from building, and nothing here authorizes it. The two install preconditions that remained after this build are both human: an independent visual review by someone other than the agent that rendered the pages, and output-level legal approval. This lane can request both and grant neither.
